headline: Swaraj Suiting schedules extraordinary general meeting for October 2026
hook: Upcoming vote for Swaraj Suiting holders
summary: Swaraj Suiting Limited has notified the stock exchange about an upcoming extraordinary general meeting scheduled for October 24, 2026. The company issued the formal notice to shareholders as part of regulatory compliance for corporate actions. Retail investors holding shares in the company should note the meeting date for potential voting matters. Such procedural filings have a minimal direct impact on broader market sentiment.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate meeting notice for shareholders.

headline: Swaraj Suiting holds its annual general meeting
summary: Swaraj Suiting Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding the proceedings of its annual general meeting held on September 30, 2026. Such filings are standard regulatory compliance procedures required for listed companies. For an Indian retail investor, this routine update carries no immediate financial consequence or impact on share price.
why_it_matters: No direct impact on retail portfolios.
